summary.text: Anthony Dickson is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 82 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Karen Mathiak (R).
He ran for the Georgia House in 2022 and 2024 and lost both general elections.

paragraphs.text: Anthony Dickson was born in Griffin, Georgia, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Mercer University in 1998 and a graduate degree from Strayer University in 2007, and his career experience includes working as a director.
Dickson ran in District 134 in 2022, losing the general election to incumbent David Knight.
In 2024 he ran in District 82 and lost to incumbent Karen Mathiak.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he wrote that he believed voters wanted a leader committed to transparency and to laws that do not discriminate or divide families.
